title: Name the arguments with with
objective: Call a function with named arguments using with, so each value is labelled by its parameter name.

body.text: A call can name each argument with the parameter it goes to. Write with, then the parameter name, then its value. Separate the arguments with and. The order no longer matters, and the call is easier to read when a function has several inputs.

body.title: One labelled argument
body.code:
function greet
    takes text called name
    say "Hello, {name}!"

greet with name "Ada"

body.text: The same form works for a structure. Each has field is named, so with fills in the field by name.

body.title: Labelled structure fields
body.code:
structure point
    has x of type number
    has y of type number

make point equal to a point with x 3 and y 4
say point

body.title: Several labelled arguments
body.code:
function format date
    takes number called year
    takes number called month
    takes number called day
    gives back "{year}-{month}-{day}"

say format date with year 2026 and month 9 and day 7
